findings.title: Reject success when requested outer-FPU entries were not measured
findings.reason: fpu=1 block is skipped once a prior boot/frame/probe/LOS primary exists, but expected-negative branches still return success with no FPU rows/problem. Additionally, the new test explicitly accepts mode=decline/ask=fpu/fpu_rounding=0,2: only RC0 probe is eligible; RC2 returnsPOISONED/judged=false, yet requested multi-RC run succeeds. Thus a requested FPU gate can be silently unmeasured or partial even though its refusal is genuine.
findings.correction: Track requested eligible entries/RCs and refuse unavailable/unmeasured FPU coverage on earlier primary, including earlyboot return. For negative controls minimally preflight-require a single RC per fresh process (or fail on any eligibility shortfall); healthy multi-RC stays valid. Add real-script skippedboot/frame/probe/LOS and requestedRC-shortfall controls, preserving raw evidence and unrelated-primary classification. No numerical kernel or production macro change required.

findings.title: Qualify rounding-result claim at exact midpoints
findings.reason: New prose says nearest_f32 RESULT does not depend on rounding mode; unchanged helper intentionally gives the initial cast result precedence at an exact distance tie. At midpoint1+3*2^-24, RZ and upward guesses differ, so the cast-winning tie policy is mode-dependent. The actual boundary is forced to RZ and current tests cover RZ, so this is an overbroad claim, not a requested kernel change.
findings.correction: Document supported RZ narrowing/tie behavior and measured numeric tests. Do not claim all-mode result independence from RZ-only checks or change closed kernel/oracles to satisfy wording.

source_safety_assessment: New outer C harness is feature-only and calls actual eech_engine_model_host_probe/counters, not a stand-in. It is outside ENTER, so it can observe what the production public entry returns to its Ccaller.

For x86/x64 it uses bounded28-byte x87 environment image (statusoffset4), masks all exceptions before seedingdivide/underflow/inexact flags, sets requested RC in x87/MXCSR without new reserved bits, captures words immediately after entry and restores original environment plusMXCSR before formatting. Real public entry owns its fatal setjmp target; no longjmp crosses active Rust callback frames because callback returns error before Cfatal.

Request args/ranges/capacity and snprintf growth are bounded; C ABI adds only a private fixture function with matching int/pointer signature. Non-x86 reportsBAD_ARGUMENT, not invented measurements. Production eech_engine.c/ENTER/LEAVE is byte-unchanged; oneembeddedNUL preserved.
Scene/public provider data, f9 math/store, callback ownership, original-model provenance, all828 observations and old driver remain closed/unchanged. No physical expected values or tolerance changed.

The diagnostic currently seeds identical RC choice into bothunits and captures complete control/status/MXCSR words; masksallset/nonzeroflags make these meaningful success/refusal tests. It does not establish allpossible caller states, arbitrary unmasked environments or completed shipping proof.
